name: PlayStation
design_analysis_text: 現行加拿大法文首頁以 Sony 黑色品牌帶、白色 PlayStation 導覽及 Wolverine 黃色活動帶開場；首張主視覺是 FC27，七張活動縮圖包含 LISA 與 DualSense。下方依序為 PS5 主機與配件、十二款新遊戲、PlayStation Plus、仍標示 EN SEPTEMBRE 的官方月度專題、商店優惠、10 月8/7/6日最新部落格文章、社群及完整藍色頁尾。窄版採單欄與水平卡片，來源的 Sony 黑帶實際位於頁底，照原樣保留。相較舊稿，活動與文章已更新，因此真正呼叫 Google Stitch MCP 取得新 DESKTOP/MOBILE 輸出，保留原始匯出，再依官方完整 DOM、樣式與289個原始素材校正。
visual_review_text: Owner inspected all six final montage rasters:10 desktop and9 narrow original viewport segments per side, with exact native1280×720 and390×844 dimensions. Continuous full-page coverage reaches6570px desktop and7390px narrow on both sides. Current FC27 hero, seven campaign thumbnails, hardware, games, Plus, editorial, store, blog, social and footer were compared. Official/local narrow root-menu rasters were inspected; local opening and Escape closing passed. Native provider thumbnails were inspected and remain unaccepted because they invent a different FC hero/theme and claims. Browser build fingerprints and capture-time preview SHA bind final local captures to the current file; old cached, cropped and pre-correction diagnostics are retained separately and excluded.
implementation_method: Source-backed correction after genuine native Google Stitch edit. Complete per-width current public DOM/CSS and observed original assets, recursively expanded CSS imports and SST/font originals retained; application/network scripts omitted. Native original exports unchanged.
corrections: Replaced old campaign thumbnail and blog content with observed LISA, FC27 and October8/7/6 source content; preserved the source September editorial wording.

Restored source CSS imports, SST and AlternateGotNo1D original fonts, SVG fragment mappings and scoped symbol styles. Corrected three lazily blank top-reference images using their preserved same-width bottom-reference originals.

Restored Sony/header initial positions and fixed-header flow height, keeping whole-page6570/7390px heights. Frozen Wolverine headline/call-to-action computed frame and approximated banner dismissal at1.5 viewport scroll lengths.
Recreated and tested the observed narrow root menu opening and Escape closing.
remaining_differences_and_limits: Official Wolverine ribbon uses time/scroll-reactive ghost lettering, clipping, opacity and dismissal. Local uses a frozen observed frame and a scroll-threshold approximation. Narrow phase1688 source retains a dark fading ribbon while local has already hidden it; exact animation timing is unresolved.

Hero entrance animation and carousel state are frozen to FC27. Small first-heading entrance-position differences remain; carousel/autoplay, campaign thumbnails, hardware selection, games tabs, horizontal rows and footer accordions are not implemented or exhaustively verified.

Narrow root menu opening and Escape closing were tested; nested menus, desktop menus, search, country selection, sign-in, purchases and subscriptions remain unverified. Menu native focus-ring and scrollbar appearance differs.

Source initial loading had transient failed image requests; final canonical visible main-page images recovered. Original raw bundle errors and excluded cached/cropped diagnostics are retained and do not count as current matching evidence.
Native provider output remains unaccepted. Other locales, widths, physical phones, authenticated services and hosted-publication parity are not claimed.
progress_note: Current-hash complete desktop/narrow actual raster comparison finished:6570/7390px, current campaign/blog/font/assets/menu corrected; ribbon and carousel motion/UI/service limits explicit; accepted=false.
